title: Law 2 Probe: 32x32 RGB Sprites with ResNet+GroupNorm + ViT Critic
intuition: Tests Law 2 differentiation faithfulness and architectural generality on 32x32x3 4-class RGB geometric sprites (red ring, green cross, blue frame, gold diamond) scored by a ResNet+GroupNorm + Patch-4 multi-head attention (ViT) critic.
failure_mode: Forward-mode `fwAD` crashes or loses fidelity on SDPA attention / GroupNorm critics where exact reverse-over-reverse (RoR) is required, or micro-secant finite differences collapse under high-dimensional RGB perturbations.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence diagnostic probe (600 updates, 32x32x3 RGB sprites).
